children.description: The MMSON website builder, or "MoonMoon's JSON-based Website Builder," is a tool which can dynamically render React apps based on simple JSON configuration files, providing a host of pre-built components.

children.description: What began as a personal challenge to flex my creative writing capabilities expanded into a more formal exercise due to popular demand. This blog was a mechanism for keeping myself accountable and to collect the relevant writing in one convenient place.
children.label: Blog (Creative Writing)
children.title: Creativity comes in many forms

children.description: Developed in collaboration with Brittany Devoe and Christine Garinger with art by Sylvia Pozeg, MindGame is a trivia bingo game intended to reduce the stigma associated with mental illness.
children.label: MindGame
children.note: As Flash is now an unsupported technology, you'll need an emulator of some kind to run the swf.
